"Vanity of vanities! All is vanity." What does the Preacher mean, and do you ever feel this way?
Generations come and go, and there is nothing new under the sun. How does this make you think about your life?
The Preacher sought wisdom and found it was like chasing the wind. What are you chasing?
The Preacher tried pleasure, building and wealth but found them empty. What do people chase for happiness today?
Wise and foolish both die. How does this make you think about what really matters?
Eating, drinking and finding enjoyment in work are from the hand of God. How can you enjoy God's everyday gifts?
"For everything there is a season." What season are you in right now?
"He has made everything beautiful in its time. Also, he has put eternity into man's heart." What longing for eternity do you feel?
Joy in eating, drinking and work is God's gift. How can you receive today's ordinary gifts with thanks?
"Whatever God does endures forever." How does this give you security?
The Preacher saw the tears of the oppressed with no one to comfort them. Who needs comfort around you?
"Better is a handful of quietness than two hands full of toil." Where do you need more quietness?
"Two are better than one... a threefold cord is not quickly broken." Who stands with you?
"Guard your steps when you go to the house of God... let your words be few." How do you come to worship?
"When you vow a vow to God, do not delay paying it." What have you promised God?
"He who loves money will not be satisfied with money." What does contentment look like for you?
God keeps a person occupied with joy in his heart. What gives you joy?
A man had wealth but could not enjoy it. Why can't possessions satisfy?
"All the toil of man is for his mouth, yet his appetite is not satisfied." What only God can satisfy?
"It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting." What can grief teach us?
"The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit. Be not quick in your spirit to become angry." Where do you need patience?
"In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider: God has made the one as well as the other." How does this help you in both?
"Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and never sins." What does this show about our need for God?
Wisdom makes a person's face shine. How does wisdom show in a life?
"It will be well with those who fear God." How does this give hope when things seem unfair?
No one can find out all the work of God. How do you live with mystery?
"A living dog is better than a dead lion." What does it mean to make the most of life?
"Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might." What work do you need to give your best to?
A poor wise man saved a city but was forgotten. How do you serve when no one remembers?
"Dead flies make the perfumer's ointment give off a stench." How can small foolishness spoil much good?
"The words of a wise man's mouth win him favour." How can your words be wise?
"Through sloth the roof sinks in." What might you be neglecting?
"Cast your bread upon the waters." What would generous, faith-filled giving look like for you?
"You do not know the work of God who makes everything... In the morning sow your seed." How can you keep sowing without seeing results?
"Rejoice, O young man, in your youth." How can you enjoy life while remembering God?
"Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth." How can you remember God at every stage?
The Preacher describes life ending. How does the shortness of life shape your priorities?
"Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the whole duty of man." What does this conclusion mean for you?
